en: Black‑and‑white view of a large multi‑storey grand hotel or sanatorium style building set alone in a forested, hilly landscape. The symmetrical structure has a long façade with many evenly spaced windows, dormers on a steep roof, and a central entrance with an arched doorway. The lower floor appears to be a terrace or veranda level. Dense coniferous forest rises behind the building, and a curving path or road with landscaped grounds lies in the foreground. There is faint, small text on the façade that is hard to read.
